items.q: Does it cost anything to join as a creator?
items.a: No. Joining N°1 Creators is free, and we never take a cut of what you earn.
On paid campaigns, the brand pays your agreed rate by PayPal once they approve your content. On affiliate campaigns, you earn a commission on every sale from your code or link.

items.a: Apply anyway and show us your best videos. Some brands post UGC on their own pages, so great content can matter more than follower count.
You do. Each campaign says how the brand can use it (for example, on their page and in ads for 90 days) before you accept.

items.q: What counts as a collaboration for brands?

items.q: Can you run our campaigns for us?
